When you move from one chord to another, each note is a melodic line. The simplest rules:

1. Keep the common note. From [[C]] to [[Am]], the notes C and E stay still and only G goes to A.

3. Don't let two voices move in parallel fifths or octaves. It destroys the independence of the lines.

4. Leading note up, seventh down.
